description.text: Minna no WAKUWAKU Battle (everyone's exciting battle), a party set released on 16 November 2012 for Christmas and New Year gatherings. Its 120 cards, eight of them holo, come as eight 15-card sets that combine two at a time into half decks, and with two of each playmat, coin and damage counter sheet up to four people can play at once. Twelve WAKUWAKU rule cards, found only here and not allowed in official tournaments, change the rules, for more than 400 ways to play.
